name: Her Old Recipes
source:
In a small snowy village, a very grumpy weasel uses his talent in magic to create a new assistant for his bakery. 

The big wolf may be a bit confused and  naive, but he will soon notice that Rosso has a very good reason to be so tense all the time.

[From [url=https://noahcarroto.itch.io/her-old-recipes]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一个白雪皑皑的小村庄里，一只脾气暴躁的黄鼠狼利用他的魔法天赋为他的面包店创造了一个新助手。

大狼可能有点困惑和天真，但他很快就会发现罗索一直如此紧张是有充分理由的。

[来自[url=https://noahcarroto.itch.io/her-old-recipes]Itch.io[/url]]
